title: Firecrawl: The Open-Source API That Turns Any Website Into AI-Ready Data
description:
Firecrawl is the open-source API to search, scrape, and interact with the web at scale. It turns any website into clean Markdown or structured JSON that AI agents and LLM apps can actually use, covering 96% of the web including JS-heavy pages with no proxy headaches on your end.

Under the hood it handles the hard stuff for you: rotating proxies, orchestration, and rate limits, with a P95 latency of 3.4 seconds across millions of pages. It also parses web-hosted PDFs and DOCX files, and supports Actions like click, scroll, write, wait, and press so you can interact with a page before extracting content.

The API is built around a few core capabilities: Search the web and pull full page content from results, Scrape any URL into markdown/HTML/JSON/screenshots, Crawl an entire site with one request, Map a site to discover every URL instantly, Batch Scrape thousands of URLs asynchronously, and an Agent mode where you just describe the data you need. It's also agent-ready, connecting to any AI agent or MCP client with a single command.

Firecrawl is fully open source and developed transparently, and it's also available as a hosted service if you'd rather skip the infrastructure.

https://github.com/firecrawl/firecrawl
